evidence.exact_quote: Democrats have won both the US Senate and House of Representatives, taking control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's presidency.
Trump spoke throughout the evening to a number of US media outlets, striking a conciliatory tone and conceding that the Democrats did a "good job".
Today begins the great American comeback," he told a crowd of supporters.

framing_claims.text: BBC presenta las elecciones de medio término como una victoria histórica de los demócratas que cambian el equilibrio de poder en el Congreso.

language_claims.descriptive_alternative: inicio de una nueva etapa política para los demócratas
